title: AFNO: Universal Certifiably-Arbitrage-Free Operator Learning Framework for European Call-Price Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.12899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural operators (NOs) have been introduced as deep learning-powered solutions to the computational bottleneck of solving families of problems. Once trained, an NO can rapidly output approximate solutions, avoiding the need to rerun classical solvers. However, standard NO architectures cannot guarantee static no-arbitrage when predicting European call-price surfaces from market or model features and, as we verify experimentally, can yield negative PnL in downstream trading tasks.   We introduce a certifiably arbitrage-free (AF) and universal encoder-decoder NO framework, continuously mapping inputs from a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) $\mathcal{H}$ over any fixed subset of $[0,\infty)^2$ to a convex combination of arbitrage-free European call-price surfaces by continuously solving an approximate nearest-neighbour problem. translated_title: AFNO：面向欧式看涨期权价格曲面的通用可证明无套利算子学习框架
translated_abstract: 神经算子（NO）作为深度学习驱动的解决方案被提出，用于解决求解问题族时的计算瓶颈。经过训练后，神经算子能够快速输出近似解，避免了重新运行经典求解器的需要。然而，当根据市场或模型特征预测欧式看涨期权价格曲面时，标准神经算子架构无法保证静态无套利，并且正如我们通过实验所验证的，其在下游交易任务中可能产生负的盈亏（PnL）。我们提出了一种可证明无套利（AF）且通用的编码器-解码器神经算子框架，通过连续求解一个近似最近邻问题，将定义在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）$\mathcal{H}$ 上（其定义域为 $[0,\infty)^2$ 的任意固定子集）的输入，连续地映射为无套利欧式看涨期权价格曲面的凸组合。我们证明了对于无约束预测的曲面，其最近的无套利修正未必存在……
tldr: 该论文提出了AFNO——一个可证明无套利且通用的神经算子学习框架，通过连续求解近似最近邻问题将输入映射为无套利欧式看涨期权价格曲面的凸组合，解决了标准神经算子在期权定价中无法保证无套利并可能导致负盈亏的问题。
en_tdlr: We introduce AFNO, a universal certifiably arbitrage-free neural operator framework that continuously maps inputs to convex combinations of arbitrage-free European call-price surfaces via an approximate nearest-neighbour problem, addressing the arbitrage violations and negative PnL issues of standard neural operators in option pricing.
